problem: The kept-on-purpose rebuild banner is not reachable from the app. rebuild() sets source "rebuild" only when onRebuild() rejects. The app's onRebuild (App.tsx rebuildGraph: `new Promise<boolean>(resolve => { void runProject(["gdgraph", "build"], ..., code => resolve(code === 0)).then(started => { if (!started) resolve(false); }); })`) never rejects: a failed build resolves false, and useProjectRunner reports it as an error toast ("Build Metaproject graph failed", exit code). So every row of the worker's table with 'failed rebuild' is pinned by tests that reject onRebuild by hand, and none is seen by a user today. If a later onRebuild does reject, the banner would read as the raw error text, would not say that the rebuild failed (the banner carries no copy from `source`), and its Retry re-reads the catalog and does not rebuild; the loud read clears the message at its start (`setError(null)`), so after one click the failure is gone, the graph is still stale, and nothing was rebuilt.
impact: Today: nothing, the path has no trigger; the tests and the table describe a state no user reaches. If it becomes reachable: a user who clicks Retry on a failed rebuild believes the build was retried, and instead loses the message while the graph stays stale (the 'Rebuild graph' button below still shows).
suggested_fix: Either say in the comment at the `error` state that the rebuild source exists for an onRebuild that rejects and the app's does not, or, when it is wired up, give the rebuild banner its own copy ('Rebuild failed: ...') and its action the same name; use `error.source` in the banner, which nothing reads now.

problem: A Rebuild the user starts clears a standing catalog-read failure at its start, whatever the build does next (the new test 'a rebuild the user starts removes a failed catalog read's banner, and one that reloads nothing leaves it gone' pins it, and the result file's assumption says it is as before). With the app's onRebuild a failed build resolves false, so no catalog read follows. Trigger: a catalog reload failed after a first success (banner 'The index is being written.' with Retry), the graph is not ready so 'Rebuild graph' shows, the user clicks it, the build exits non-zero. Outcome: the red alert is gone, no catalog read was made, the screen holds the old catalog, and the only signal is the toast about the build. A later return does not report it either (a failed quiet re-read shows nothing).
impact: The user is shown an older catalog with no indication that the last read of it failed; the stale graph banner and the build toast stay, so they are not misled about the build, only about the catalog read.
suggested_fix: Clear the banner when the rebuild's reload succeeds (the loud read already clears at its start) and leave it when onRebuild resolves false; or accept it as designed and keep the test.
